subtitle: Safer meat stacks with clear cooking and smoking timers.
description: Improves meat handling by separating stacks by state, blocking raw and spoiled meat consumption, and adding clear cooking and smoking countdowns.
features: Raw, cooked, smoked and spoiled meat are kept out of newly mixed stacks.
The mod does not change the vanilla stack size; capacity still comes from the game or another storage mod.
Raw and spoiled meat consumption is blocked while cooked and smoked meat remains usable.
A HUD countdown shows the remaining cooking time.
Smoking has its own countdown because cooking and smoking progress in parallel.
Cooking and smoking progress is shown visually.
The HUD supports local split-screen and can present status to both players.
Existing mixed stacks are not force-migrated; the mod prevents new invalid combinations instead.

faq.question: Does Better Meat change meat stack size?
faq.answer: No. It only checks whether meat states are compatible with a stack.

faq.question: Why are there separate cooking and smoking timers?
faq.answer: Stranded Deep advances cooking and smoking in parallel, so the two completion times are different.

faq.question: Does the HUD support local split-screen?
faq.answer: Yes. It is designed for two players on the same PC and uses the appropriate player UI.

faq.question: What happens to old mixed stacks?
faq.answer: They are not aggressively migrated. The mod leaves them in place and prevents new incompatible additions.

faq.question: Does the mod save a separate meat state?
faq.answer: No. Meat state is derived from the game's own Cooking, Smoking and Spoiled data.
